home.heroTitle: Bespoke websites that win you customers
home.heroBody: I'm a freelance web developer building fast, custom websites and online shops with WordPress, Next.js and Shopify — no templates, no bloat, built to rank on Google. Need help after launch? Add maintenance, SEO or Google Business Profile support — only what you actually need.
home.logosTitle: The platforms and tools I work with every day
home.servicesTitle: Website design, online store development, SEO and maintenance
home.servicesLead: From a simple business website to a full online store — I choose the platform that fits your goals: WordPress, Next.js or Shopify. Optional extras: SEO services, Google Business Profile optimisation and website maintenance.
home.workTitle: Web design portfolio: websites and online stores that perform
home.workLead: Business websites, online stores and SEO projects for clients in Lithuania and abroad, with results you can measure: 226× more Google impressions, #2 in the Google map pack and a 100 PageSpeed score.
home.aboutBody: You work directly with the person who designs, builds and maintains your site — no account-manager relay, no “I'll pass it to the team”. Clear price, clear timelines, and a website you fully own.
home.pricingBody: From basic updates and backups to ongoing speed and SEO work — pick the plan that fits your site. Cancel any time, no penalties.
home.blogTitle: Practical tips on websites, SEO and Google
home.ctaTitle: Planning a new website or online shop?
home.ctaBody: Tell me what you want to achieve. Within one business day you'll get a reply with first ideas and a ballpark price.
